description: Extract plain text from a local PDF. Optionally restrict to a page range like "1-5" or "1,3,5-7". Output is split by page with === Page N === markers.

pages.description: Page range (1-based). Examples: "3", "1-5", "1,3,5-7". Omit for all pages.

path.description: Absolute path to a PDF on the local filesystem.

name: extract_text
title: Extract text
